Title: Azure Database for MySQL support for intelligent performance is now available

Body.Content:
Azure Database for MySQL support for the intelligent performance set of features, which includes query store, query performance insight, and performance recommendations, is now generally available. This set of features provides the ability for you to better understand your workloads, including the ability to visually inspect them, and to identify bottlenecks. Use this functionality to view a list of recommendations for improving the performance of your workloads.

Learn more about performance recommendations for Azure Database for MySQL.

Learn more about query performance insight for Azure Database for MySQL.

Learn more about query store for Azure Database for MySQL.
